operation_accounting.O_ms: max wall duration of complete nondivided atomic interval on one engine clock: from last budget/token checkpoint immediately before root/NN/search op through its full feature/NN/validation/backup until next coherent checkpoint. Include root expansion; root/step wrappers may contain NN
operation_accounting.nested_spans: NN/feature/BFS/root/backup diagnostic labels are inclusive children; max atomic wrapper once, never sum parent+NN; partial unfinished op is lower bound and invalidates qualification
operation_accounting.F_ms: max per-hand [pre-dispatch transport/adapter interval from caller t0 until first atomic start] + [post-atomic tail from last coherent atomic end through finish/owned snapshot/serialization/postMessage to caller final t1], corrected with fixed offset midpoints. Disjoint pre+tail; does not include atomic NN interval
operation_accounting.F_overlap: finish included in tail, do not add separately. Multiple intermediate snapshot/step costs belong O if inside atomic wrapper; final owned materialization belongs F exactly once. No negative duration or clipped fabricated zero
operation_accounting.C_ms: 2*max start offset halfwidth plus drift allowance as above; handles uncertainty of pre/tail offset conversions, not NN local deltas
operation_accounting.instrumentation_gate: complete chronological raw stamps required. Existing reference finish_ms=0 or candidate root aggregate without span completeness is insufficient; unknown=>null/missing gate, not0
operation_accounting.formula: g=ceil(max O over all144 + max F over all144 + C +5ms)
